schema_status.note: Task-scoped pre-review evidence for reviewer CLI guidance and worker-context discoverability. This task changes no approval decision, task-state persistence, merge-gate, deployment, or capital authority.

task.title: Surface the REVIEW_PR/REVIEW_HEAD_SHA approval-binding requirement so reviewer workers stop landing unbound approves
task.phase: Supervisor Runtime Repair / Review Gate Reliability

scope.owned_layer: Reviewer-facing approve usage and unbound-warning text, a dedicated exact-head binding skill, and injection of that skill into every task worker's context file list.
not_changing: resolve_approval_binding decision branches and binding validation rules
discover_open_pr_binding live GitHub discovery behavior from current dev
approval-state persistence, GitHub review bridge behavior, and merge-gate enforcement
supervisor scheduling, worker eligibility, task ownership, and dispatch authority

root_cause.summary: The approve usage string did not mention REVIEW_PR or REVIEW_HEAD_SHA, and no reviewer-facing worker context explained how to bind approval to the exact PR head. When a binding was unavailable, reviewers could receive only a late warning or merge-gate rejection and had to repeat review.
root_cause.repair_boundary: Expose actionable environment-variable and gh lookup guidance at the CLI and prompt/documentation layers while preserving the existing binding and live-discovery logic.

acceptance.statement: approve usage and missing-binding diagnostics name REVIEW_PR and REVIEW_HEAD_SHA and show how to fetch headRefOid.
acceptance.evidence: approval_binding_guidance() is reused by command usage, the PR-backed refusal, and the unbound warning; regression tests assert REVIEW_PR and the exact gh pr view command.

acceptance.statement: A dedicated reviewer skill documents exact-head capture, optional REVIEW_BASE, REVIEW_FILE preconditions, and re-review after head movement.
acceptance.evidence: .orchestrator/skills/reviewer-approval-binding.md contains the governed command and failure-handling procedure.

acceptance.statement: Reviewer workers receive the new skill through an existing dispatch context path instead of relying on an unlinked file.
acceptance.evidence: worker_execution_context_files() includes reviewer-approval-binding.md; its exact ordered output is covered by test_queue_delivery_event_seeds_non_materializing_worker_context. chairman-review.md also points chair recommendations to the same skill.

acceptance.statement: The complete scripts/test_ai_status.py suite and focused supervisor context regression pass.
acceptance.evidence: 208 tests and 31 subtests passed in scripts/test_ai_status.py; 1 focused supervisor context-builder test passed.

acceptance.statement: The task does not modify resolve_approval_binding's core decision logic.
acceptance.evidence: The diff adds a shared guidance formatter and substitutes diagnostic text only. Current dev's live PR discovery, explicit-pair validation, returned binding shapes, and unbound decision branches are preserved.

independent_checks_requested: Confirm the usage, PR-backed refusal, and unbound warning all expose REVIEW_PR, REVIEW_HEAD_SHA, and the headRefOid lookup command.
Confirm reviewer-approval-binding.md requires the exact reviewed PR head and an already-committed evidence manifest.
Confirm worker_execution_context_files injects the new skill without changing dispatch selection or scheduling.
Confirm resolve_approval_binding and discover_open_pr_binding retain current dev decision behavior.

rollout_and_rollback.rollout: Merge the task PR into dev; the next promoted command runtime and supervisor runtime will expose the CLI text and worker-context skill.
rollout_and_rollback.rollback: Revert the task PR. No task-state migration or runtime data rollback is required.
